name: docs-deployment-docker-md-05
yaml:
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
      - "4545:4545"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rift", "healthcheck"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  tests:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.test
    environment:
      - MOCK_SERVER_URL=http://rift:4545
      - MOCK_ADMIN_URL=http://rift:2525
    depends_on:
      rift:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: ["npm", "test"]
